arguments.summary: Implemented configurable bounded exponential retry policy in jobrunner. RetryConfig gained max_delay_ms and retry_delay_ms() using saturating arithmetic (shift guarded at retry_index >= 63), so delays saturate at max_delay_ms without overflow even for u32::MAX retry index.
